name: Hester Gale
description: Shadows under her eyes. A milk stain on one shoulder she hasn't noticed.

visits.greeting: Hello. Sorry. I've about ten minutes before my sister gives up on the baby.

request.text: Small Comforts? Something soothing. For me, not the baby. I haven't slept in weeks.

readThoughts.default: Ten minutes. Ten minutes of nothing at all.

purpose.0: For me. Just for me, for once.

experience.0: I used to know a charm for hiccups. It's gone. Everything's gone.

good.text: Slept four hours together. It felt like a holiday. Thank you. — Hester
